given_when_then.given: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows sufficient available quantity for all items in an Order Request
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock
given_when_then.then: The system immediately deducts the reserved quantities from the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot

given_when_then.given: No Store Partner has sufficient inventory to fulfill the complete Order Request
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine attempts to assign the order
given_when_then.then: The system does not assign the order and flags it for manual review

given_when_then.given: Multiple Store Partners have sufficient inventory for the Order Request
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
given_when_then.then: The system assigns the order to the nearest store based on the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time

success_criteria: The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot reflects deducted reserved quantities immediately after automatic assignment
Orders are assigned only when the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot shows available quantity greater than or equal to the requested quantity for all items
Orders are not assigned if no store has sufficient inventory and are instead flagged for manual review
Orders are prioritized to the nearest store based on shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time
